arguments.need: I want to run a big mixture-of-experts language model on my own machine, but it's larger than my GPU's memory, so I need something that can spill parts of it into system RAM and the SSD. I'd also like to compress a Hugging Face safetensors checkpoint myself with mixed precision so quality doesn't tank. It has to be open source, and it needs to expose an OpenAI-compatible API so my existing apps and agents can talk to it.
